headline: Philippines Increases Direct Rice Imports from Cambodia
summary: The Philippines, the world's largest rice importer, is increasing direct rice purchases from Cambodia to diversify its national supply sources.
why: Diversifying food import origins helps major consuming nations mitigate agricultural supply chain shocks and price volatility.

impacts.name: Rice
impacts.why: Shifting bilateral trade volumes impacts regional grain export flows and supply diversification.
